title: CSV column contract (schema-of-schemas)
description: Validates datasets/data/_schema/columns.json - the one machine-readable home for the per-file-class CSV column contract. Spec: docs/architecture/data/csv-column-contract.md (D-DOC0). Consumed by the backend write-time validator (B1.3), the frontend typed-read codegen (F1), and the cross-format drift test.

x-changelog.description: Initial sub-plan B1.1 schema for the columns.json artifact. Mirrors csv-column-contract.md sections 2-4: file-class keyed by canonical-tree glob; per-column {name, dtype, nullable, pk?, fk?, enum?, derived?}; closed-enum membership; no second hand-typed column-name copy permitted.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 1.0 -> 1.1 (PR-0 of TODO/20260610-electoral-data-quality-and-party-catalogue-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: 10 nullable identity-metadata columns appended to the datasets/data/entities/parties.csv file-class (recognition_scope, home_state_codes, founded_year, dissolved_year, predecessor_party_ids, successor_party_ids, name_history, claims_to_parent_name, name_native_script, is_sentinel) per Hans + Gregor Wave 0 verdict (plan section 2.1). Existing rows unchanged in shape; 3 sentinel rows (parties.IN.UNK / parties.IN.IND / parties.IN.NOTA) lifted from adapter hardcodes into the CSV so FK closure now includes them (Hans Wave 0 / section 2.1).

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 1.1 -> 2.0 (Phase 1 of TODO/20260612-alliance-phase-1-structural-fix-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; MAJOR breaking on the datasets/data/entities/party_alliances.csv file-class: renamed period_label -> event_id so the column joins citizen-route canonical event_id values (general-2024, assembly-2024, ...); added state column (LGD state slug for state-scoped events, literal IN for national events) to disambiguate per-state cohorts that share an event_id; dropped short_name (Holy Law #6 - readers join through party_id FK to parties.csv.short_name). PK changed from (party_id, period_label) to (party_id, event_id, state). All 61 existing on-disk rows migrated 1:1 in the same commit (no row loss); the 10 TN-AcGenMay2026 rows additionally repointed to a new Wikipedia src_id (src-bca3c60cdafb) for the 2026 Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly election article (Resolution A; the legacy src-c3e2fd43efa5 row in source.csv stays as the legitimate citation for the 1999-LS data it actually describes).

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 2.0 -> 2.1 (PR-A of TODO/20260614-three-ephemeral-ingests-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: NEW file-class datasets/elections/parliament/election=*/mcc_seizures.csv for the ECI MCC-period daily enforcement-seizures press-note series (national 17th-LS 2019 press-note, 36 states/UTs x 10 dates = 360 rows, composite PK (state_slug, date), 13 columns). Publisher's TOTAL is preserved verbatim (D3 'no derived totals') so total_seizure_inr_crore is NOT derived; consumers MUST NOT recompute it. The 2 pre-2020-merger UTs (Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu) are kept on their historical slugs (dadra-and-nagar-haveli, daman-and-diu) - not the merged dadra-and-nagar-haveli-and-daman-and-diu slug - because the 2019 publisher rows are historically distinct; state_slug in this file-class has no FK declared (per-event publisher-distinct identity, not a state_codes.csv reference). Existing file-classes unchanged in shape.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 2.1 -> 2.2 (PR-E1 of TODO/20260615-elections-redesign-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: NEW file-class datasets/data/marts/elections/event_summary.csv (12 columns, composite PK (event_id, state_code)) for the per-event aggregate emitted by `python -m yen_gov derive-event-summary`. Lives under marts/ alongside the party_pages mart (history.csv, strongholds.csv, manifest.csv) - the established home for derived aggregate CSVs. scope is a 2-value enum (national | state). state_code is nullable AND part of the composite PK (null for scope=national rows, the single Parliament row per event_id; non-null for scope=state rows, the per-Assembly rows). turnout_pct + seats_contested are derived event-scope aggregates of the upstream summary.csv. leading_party_id + runner_up_party_id FK parties.csv.party_id; source_id FK source.csv.source_id. Existing file-classes unchanged in shape.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 2.2 -> 2.3 (PR-1 of TODO/20260615-party-page-citizen-fixes-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: 3 nullable trailing columns appended to datasets/data/entities/parties.csv file-class (source_id FK datasets/data/entities/source.csv.source_id, processing_level enum [minor, major], processing_note free-text) per user-ratified Path A (Scope-change ledger L-4) and the L-1 per-row processing-level doctrine at docs/concepts/data-quality.md. The bump unblocks PR-1 D1 founded_year backfill (952 of 2776 rows previously null) by giving the catalogue a place to record the issuing-authority source_id + the per-row processing receipt per CLAUDE.md Holy Law #9 + section 12 + the OWID-aligned per-row scope (named divergence #6, docs/concepts/owid-alignment.md). All 2779 pre-v1.2 rows ship the 3 trailing fields empty (no semantic change); the 14 priority parties get founded_year + the 3 provenance fields populated via the canonical helpers (backend.yen_gov.canonical.processing_quality.derive_processing_for_party_founded_year_backfill + backend.yen_gov.canonical.citation.derive_source_id) per CLAUDE.md section 10 anti-pattern (NO hand-authored literals). Other file-classes unchanged in shape.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 2.3 -> 2.4 (Row C of TODO/20260614-three-ephemeral-ingests-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: NEW file-class datasets/data/datapoints/electoral_geo/*.csv for long-format datapoints keyed to ECI electoral entities (AC + PC grain), sibling to the existing datasets/data/datapoints/geo/*.csv (which is keyed to LGD entities at country/state/district grain). The new file-class mirrors at the datapoints tier the LGD-vs-ECI issuing-authority split already cemented at the entities tier (entities/geo.csv vs entities/electoral.csv) - the FK target is entities/electoral.csv.entity_id, NOT entities/geo.csv.entity_id. 6 columns: composite PK (entity_id, time, sex); sex closed enum [male, female, third_gender]; value nullable; source_id FK into source.csv; processing_level enum [minor, major] required per the L-1 per-row processing-level doctrine. Seeds with one file (datasets/data/datapoints/electoral_geo/electors-persons-by-sex.csv, 234 TN ACs x 3 sex facets = 702 rows, vintage 2021). Unblocks the FB-2 35-state AC-grain electors-by-sex backlog, all future MLA-affidavit / ADR criminal-cases / MPLADS-by-PC datapoint shapes. Decision: Hans + Max + Fowler unanimous on Path B over Path A (widen entities/geo.csv to absorb 14,682 ACs, Level-4, rejected as LGD-vs-ECI ontology violation) and Path C (defer; rejected as 35-state coverage punt). See ledger entry 'C resolution' in TODO/20260614 plan-doc + handover TODO/20260615-row-c-tn-electors-by-sex-handover.md.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 2.4 -> 2.5 (R6 of TODO/20260615-state-election-event-page-redesign-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: NEW nullable trailing column `formation` appended to datasets/data/entities/party_alliances.csv file-class. formation enum is [pre_poll, post_poll, hybrid]; nullable so existing rows remain valid without backfill; semantically default = pre_poll (the historical assumption baked into every row authored before R6). Wired by the Max + Hans verdict in plan-doc Section 0.1 (alliance honesty): the citizen needs to distinguish pre-poll seat-sharing arrangements (e.g. NDA / INDIA / MVA / Mahayuti) from post-poll government-formation arithmetic (e.g. JD(U) joining NDA after the 2024 LS result), since they answer different civic questions. The frontend AllianceTotals caption picks the wording from the formation value (`pre_poll` -> 'Pre-poll alliance composition'; `post_poll` -> 'Post-poll government formation'; `hybrid` -> 'Mixed pre- and post-poll arrangement'); when the column is null the caption defaults to the pre-poll wording. Existing 61 on-disk rows ship the new column empty (no semantic change); curator-led backfill of the column to explicit pre_poll/post_poll/hybrid values is a follow-up. Other file-classes unchanged in shape.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 2.5 -> 2.6 (PR-B of TODO/20260614-three-ephemeral-ingests-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: 4 nullable affidavit-disclosure columns appended to BOTH candidacies file-classes (datasets/elections/parliament/election=*/candidacies.csv AND datasets/elections/assembly/state=*/election=*/candidacies.csv): criminal_cases_declared (integer, count of pending criminal cases declared on the ECI Form 26 nomination affidavit), total_assets_inr (integer, declared movable+immovable+investments, rupees), total_liabilities_inr (integer, declared liabilities, rupees), declared_election_expense_inr (integer, publisher-reported election-expense filing, rupees). PR-B populates these on 542 of 543 winner rows for election=2014 via the ADR/MyNeta corpus (1 winner is a publisher gap, NOT a join failure; D2: unmatched_count=0); NULL on losers and on every non-2014 event. Affidavit-source citation is registered in source.csv (src-e9565084cbd1, producer='Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR / MyNeta)'); the ECI src_id on the candidacy ROW stays pristine per the 'don't change published data' citizen-correctness binding (the 4 new cols' attribution is fixed at the file-class scope by THIS changelog entry). The mirror onto the AE candidacies file-class is forward-defensive: no AE writer populates these cells yet, but future AE-affidavit ingests can land without a further schema bump.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 2.6 -> 2.7 (TODO/20260616-geo-facet-dimension-column-plan.md; Level-5 data-model, Hans + Max + Gregor + Fowler debate). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: NEW file-class datasets/data/datapoints/geo_by_fuel/*.csv for long-format datapoints faceted by fuel_type, generalising the electoral_geo sex-facet precedent (v2.4) to the plan section 21.6 dimension-column branch. 5 columns: composite PK (entity_id, time, fuel_type); fuel_type closed enum [coal, gas, hydro, nuclear, renewable, all] where `all` is the published aggregate member (NOT a render-time sum of the parts); value nullable; source_id FK source.csv; entity_id FK geo.csv. Collapses the 4 installed-capacity families (each currently 1 total + 5 per-fuel variable_ids = ~24 geo/*.csv files) into 4 faceted geo_by_fuel files. The geo/*.csv note is rewritten to delete the superseded 'facet metadata lives on variables.csv row' language (ARCH-A rejected pre-commit by the Gregor contract ruling); the frontend reader stays columns.json-only. estimate_stage (net-transfers Accounts/RE/BE) is explicitly NOT modelled as a facet (fails the four-gate test F2; plan F1 'never a facet toggle'); net-transfers collapses to an Accounts-only single series in the same PR. Existing file-classes unchanged in shape.

file_class_glob.description: Glob over the canonical tree, anchored at repo root. POSIX separators only. No double-underscore in any path segment (plan section 21.6).

columns.description: Columns in EMISSION order. The CSV header MUST equal this list (no reordering, no extras, no omissions) per csv-column-contract.md section 2.

notes.description: Human-readable note carried alongside the file-class entry. Not consumed by the validator; surfaced in tooling output.

dtype.description: CSV-readable dtype. Maps 1:1 to a DuckDB read_csv() column type.

nullable.description: Whether the column may carry NULL. The writer rejects NULL on a non-nullable column; the validator rejects empty-string-on-nullable=false.

pk.description: Member of the primary key for this file class. Composite PKs declare pk:true on each member. Rows are sorted deterministically by the PK before write.

fk.description: Foreign-key target as '<file-class-glob>.<column>'. Enforced by the B1.3 validator.

enum.description: Closed-enum membership (single source per csv-column-contract.md section 4). The validator rejects values outside the set.

derived.description: F7 computed at write time, never hand-authored. The writer rejects callers that supply the column in input rows.
